# This file was generated by Chat-GPT but checked by me.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Kronecker LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")

find_package(GUROBI REQUIRED)
find_path(BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR boost/multiprecision/cpp_int.hpp
    HINTS "${BOOST_ROOT}" "$ENV{BOOST_ROOT}")
if(NOT BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Boost headers not found. Set BOOST_ROOT to the directory containing boost/.")
endif()

add_executable(kronecker
    main.cpp
    Solver.cpp
    LowerBound.cpp
    EnumerateAll.cpp
    Printing.cpp
    CondensedNode.cpp
    EdgeOrbit.cpp
    CondensedFormula.cpp
    Biclique.cpp
    DominoGraph.cpp
    BicliqueParser.cpp
    IsBiclique.cpp
    ObjThresholdCallback.cpp
    QuboSmall.cpp
    QuboEdgeorbits.cpp
    QuboLinearized.cpp
)
target_include_directories(kronecker PRIVATE "${BOOST_INCLUDE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(kronecker PRIVATE GUROBI::CXX)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(kronecker PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET kronecker POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${GUROBI_DLL}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:kronecker>"
        VERBATIM)
endif()
